data.body:
Context for this doc change (machine-local, not part of the repo diff): on the operator's
host Serena has been re-pointed from the working checkout to a dedicated read-only clone of
`origin/main`, refreshed hourly by a `StartInterval=3600` LaunchAgent modelled on the
existing `com.navapbc.rebar-dev-update`. The updater unlocks the tree, fetches, and relocks
from an EXIT trap, so a failed or interrupted update cannot leave it writable.

Verified before writing this ticket's change: a Serena read against the mirror returns
symbols; a Serena `replace_content` write against it fails with `PermissionError` and leaves
the mirror `git status` clean; the operator checkout is untouched.

That host detail is deliberately OUT of the repo change — `AGENTS.md` gets only the
host-agnostic facts (read-only mirror of `origin/main`, refreshed on a lag) so the guidance
holds for any environment configured this way.
